name: INKON Life Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: INKON Life Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on building an ecosystem platform for providing medical services for tumors in China and internationally. It provides medical devices solutions for radiotherapy, life support, image enhancement, and chronic disease treatment; and oncology medical services, as well as equipment for cancer prevention, diagnosis, treatment, and rehabilitation. The company was formerly known as Starmap Medicine and Technology Co., Ltd. and changed its name to INKON Life Technology Co., Ltd. in July 2019. INKON Life Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Qingdao, China.
